description: Paths owned by the Nora core. Child apps receive these via `node scripts/sync-core.mjs`. src/app/ is NEVER listed.

packageJson.note: Child-only dependencies are preserved; dependencies also present in core take core's version range.

cargo.note: src-tauri/Cargo.toml is replaced by core's. Child apps needing extra crates must keep them in a [dependencies] block marked '# --- child-app deps ---' which sync-core preserves.
